name: Product Vision Narrative
axiom: Write the launch announcement before the product; if it is dull, stop.
trigger: New product vetting and zero-to-one allocation, where the decision is whether the outcome is worth funding.

steps.text: Headline: the announcement, as the customer would read it.
Pain: the current workaround and what it costs.
Solution: the change in the customer's day.
Quote: a customer describing the benefit in their words.
FAQ: the hardest internal objection, answered.

antiPattern.violation: A press release written for the company instead of the customer, full of internal milestones the reader has no reason to care about.
antiPattern.remediation: Write it in the customer's vocabulary and name what they can stop doing. The internal version is the FAQ.
